intro.text: A recent book about the Unmade by the scholar Hessi. Shallan notes that it was not well received.

description.text: Hessi argues that the Unmade were not vague spirits of the void, but each a particular kind of spren holding enormous power.
Although people give them personalities and motives, she holds that they were still spren: embodiments of ideas or divine forces as much as individuals.
Her main claim is that some Unmade remain in the world today, their effects so common that people mistake them for ordinary spren.
The book is new and hard to find; the few Kholinar shops that stocked it had their copies stolen. In places it disagrees with Jasnah Kholin's work.

Hessi writes that the Radiants feared Sja-anat most of the Unmade, for corrupting what they called 'lesser' spren, and that Sja-anat was often spoken of as an individual where others were treated as forces. Old lore advised leaving a city whose spren began acting strangely.

She believes the three mindless Unmade are still about: Nergaoul as the Thrill, the battle rage that grips both sides; Moelach as the Death Rattles; and Ashertmarn, Heart of the Revel, whose hand she suspects in the excesses of Bayala in 480.

The last section turns to the ninth Unmade, about which Hessi can only guess, asking whether it was Dai-Gonarthis and whether it truly destroyed Aimia. She knows little of Ba-Ado-Mishram beyond its command of the enemy's forces, or of Chemoarish except that it is not the Nightwatcher.

items.text: Shallan finds a copy in Kholinar and uses it to work out that two Unmade are in the city: Sja-anat and Ashertmarn.
